analysis.summary: Manav Infra Projects Limited presented its annual financial and operational performance for the year ended March 31, 2026, reporting revenue from operations of Rs. 4155.77 lacs and a net profit after tax of Rs. 402.55 lacs. Management highlighted growth prospects in roads and highways, real estate, and heavy civil construction works, while deciding not to recommend any dividend for the financial year. The Board also proposed resolutions regarding managerial appointments, remuneration revisions, and enhancing borrowing and mortgage limits up to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management identified roads and highways, real estate, and other heavy civil construction works as potential growth segments.
demand_outlook.quote: MIP has identified roads & highways, real estate and other heavy civil construction works as a potential growth segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company's outlook is bright and it is poised for sustained growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company is poised for sustained growth and the outlook is bright.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: your directors do not recommended any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued 63,24,000 equity shares on a rights basis aggregating up to Rs. 695.64 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has issued 63,24,000 Equity Shares of face value Rs. 10/- each at price of Rs. 11/- each on a rights basis including premium of Rs. 1/- to existing equity shareholders of the Company (“Rights Issue”) aggregating upto Rs. 695.64 Lakhs opened for subscription on 12th March, 2025 and the subscription was closed on 24th March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company took unsecured loans from directors Mr. Mahendra Narayan Raju and Mrs. Mahalakshmi Raju amounting to Rs. 19,663,998.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has taken unsecured loan from the Director of the Company , i.e. Mr. Mahendra Narayan Raju and Mrs. Mahalakshmi Raju amounting to Rs. 19,663,998/- .

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to gradually improve its penetration and resources into roads and highways, real estate, and heavy civil construction sectors.
management_commitments.quote: In the near future the Company is desirous of gradually improving its penetration and resources to these sectors.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
